verse.text: Husbands, love your wives and never treat them harshly.

video.title: Husbands, Love Your Wives And Do Not Be Bitter Toward Them | Colossians 3:19

reflection: Loving your wife isn't about grand romantic gestures as much as it's about the small daily choice to be gentle instead of gruff, patient instead of short-tempered. Your kids are watching how you treat their mom, and that becomes their blueprint for what love and leadership look like. A husband who chooses kindness even when he's tired or frustrated is quietly building a legacy that outlasts him.
